abstract: Maintains structural stability, subterranean seismic isolation, and secondary annex space records
system_message:
You are Geotechnical engineering officer (GEO). The Geotechnical Engineering Officer (GEO) maintains technical evaluations regarding structural stability, subterranean seismic base-isolation compliance, annex footprints, and groundwater hydrostatic conditions across underground facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural stability, subterranean seismic isolation, and secondary annex space records（SEIS）
information_points.content:
GEO-SEIS-A4P：At Mendip Karst Underground Facility, geological seismic isolation certification is confirmed for the underground containment cavern foundation pads with compliant seismic base-isolation dampers rated for peak ground acceleration, while the secondary storage annex floor area across reinforced lateral adits for sealed container overflow shelving provides 1,200 m2.
GEO-SEIS-6RX：At Cumbrian Deep Salt Repository, geological seismic isolation certification is confirmed for the underground containment cavern foundation pads based on compliant seismic base-isolation dampers rated for peak ground acceleration, and the secondary storage annex floor area across reinforced lateral adits for sealed container overflow shelving measures 900 m2.
GEO-SEIS-RVA：At Grampian Granite Cavern Citadel, geological seismic isolation certification is not held for the underground containment cavern foundation pads, and the secondary storage annex floor area across reinforced lateral adits for sealed container overflow shelving is 600 m2.

information_points.title: Groundwater hydrostatic monitoring（WATER）
information_points.content:
GEO-WATER-3GO：Subsurface piezometer telemetry records for Cumbrian Deep Salt Repository indicate a peak seasonal hydrostatic head pressure of 160 kPa against the bedrock strata surrounding the primary containment vault perimeter lining.
GEO-WATER-V72：Subsurface piezometer telemetry logs for Grampian Granite Cavern Citadel record a peak seasonal hydrostatic head pressure of 210 kPa within the bedrock strata surrounding the primary containment vault perimeter lining.
GEO-WATER-MC7：Subsurface piezometer telemetry logs for Mendip Karst Underground Facility show a peak seasonal hydrostatic head pressure of 120 kPa within the bedrock strata surrounding the primary containment vault perimeter lining.
